preconditions.expression: len(lines) >= 1 and lines[0].strip().isdigit() and q := int(lines[0].strip()) >= 1 and q <= 1000
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin contains an integer q representing the number of queries, where 1 <= q <= 1000.

preconditions.expression: len(lines) == q + 1 and all(2 <= int(line.strip()) <= (2**25) - 1 for line in lines[1:])
preconditions.description: The subsequent q lines each contain a single integer a_i, where 2 <= a_i <= 2^25 - 1.

postconditions.expression: len(out_lines) == q and all(out_lines[i] == str(max(gcd((a ^ b), (a & b)) for b in range(1, a))) for i, a in enumerate(a_list))
postconditions.description: The output consists of q lines, where the i-th line is the maximum value of gcd(a_i XOR b, a_i AND b) for all integers b such that 0 < b < a_i.
